description_html:
This large studio flat is located on the 3rd floor of John Trundle Court, Barbican. It has a balcony and ceiling to floor glass windows. It has terrific east facing aspect over Beech Gardens and towards the City skyline.

This type of studio is one of the largest in the Barbican Estate (known as a Type F2A), approximately 440 sq. ft. It is comprised of an open plan original kitchen, a refurbished white tiled shower room and fitted wardrobes.

This flat is a short walk from the shopping amenities, restaurants and bars around Farringdon and Moorgate (including a large Marks and Spencer), and Whitecross Street where there is a Waitrose and a large numbers of restaurants and amenities. The closest station is Barbican (Elizabeth, Circle, Hammersmith and City and Metropolitan line). The Elizabeth line provides very quick and easy access to Canary Wharf and the West End. To the south of John Trundle Court lies Cheapside, One New Change shopping centre and St Paul's.

John Trundle Court has a 24-hour car park attendant / porter. Other residents' facilities and services: full use of the large and tranquil Barbican residents gardens; storage lockers and parking are available by separate arrangement; collection of rubbish and recycling from your door; cycle parking; tennis courts (small fee applies); and finally the jewel in the crown, the world-renowned Barbican Arts Centre with its concert hall, cinema screens, theatre, galleries, library, shops, bars and restaurants is on your doorstep.

Managed by the City of London Corporation, the Barbican Estate is the finest achievement of the architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon. It was Grade II listed in 2001 in recognition of its extraordinary contribution to London's urban landscape.

We bring this flat to the market as sole agent and there is no onward chain.

Leasehold - 172 years remaining (expiry 2196) Extended lease.
Service charge (included underfloor heating): £4,258 PA 2024/25
Ground rent - Nil
Council tax - City of London, Band D, £1,274 PA
